title: A Data-free Universal Prior over Syntactic Structures
abstract: arXiv:2609.16854v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Probability is fundamental to theories of language comprehension, production, acquisition, and evolution, as well as to large language models. Existing theories estimate the probability of syntactic structures from language-specific data. Whether part of this probability structure can arise independently of language-specific experience remains unknown. Here I show that a universal prior over syntactic structures emerges from a cognitively motivated model of incremental language production, in which words are progressively integrated into syntactic structure through network growth. The resulting prior assigns probabilities to syntactic structures --represented as dependency trees-- without fitting parameters to linguistic data, and assigns higher probabilities to attested than to random trees in all 138 typologically diverse languages examined. These prior probabilities correlate positively with probabilities estimated from corpora in 33

translated_title: 一种无需数据的句法结构通用先验
translated_abstract: 概率是语言理解、产生、习得与演化理论的基础，同样也是大语言模型的基础。现有理论从特定语言的数据中估计句法结构的概率。然而，这种概率结构的一部分是否能够独立于特定语言经验而产生，目前仍不清楚。本研究表明，一种关于句法结构的通用先验可以从一个具有认知动机的增量式语言产生模型中涌现出来——在该模型中，词语通过网络增长逐步被整合到句法结构中。由此得到的先验能够为句法结构（表示为依存树）分配概率，而无需将参数拟合到任何语言数据上；并且在所考察的全部138种类型各异的语言中，它为真实存在的依存树分配的概率均高于随机生成的树。这些先验概率与从33种语言的语料库中估计得到的概率呈正相关。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种无需任何语言数据拟合的句法结构通用先验，它从认知驱动的增量式语言产生模型中自然涌现，并在138种语言中均能为真实句法结构赋予高于随机结构的概率。
en_tdlr: This study presents a data-free universal prior over syntactic structures that emerges naturally from a cognitively motivated incremental language production model, assigning higher probabilities to attested than random dependency trees across 138 typologically diverse languages.
